title: Planer crank drill adapter
description: A drill adapter for a planer crank, with a 12 mm female hex socket. Rotate the model or section it to inspect the socket and internal geometry.
notes: The STL contains the 12 mm female hex configuration. The parametric design is available in Onshape through the CAD source link. Sections and wireframe only change the view; the download contains the complete part.
